evidence_items.notes: Three diseases directly associated with the target genes are identified in the transplant registry data: interstitial lung disease due to ABCA3 deficiency (1 lung transplant case), autosomal dominant tubulointerstitial kidney disease due to HNF1B (1 kidney transplant case), and autosomal dominant tubulointerstitial kidney disease due to UMOD mutation (1 kidney transplant case). evidence_items.value: Mean age at TR enrollment: 7.15 years (IQR 1-13 years); Mean age at transplantation: 7.99 years (IQR 1-14 years); Lung: 13.04 years at enrollment

raw_source.text_snippet: The mean age at the time of enrollment in the TR was 7.15 years, IQR [1–13 years], with differences when considering the type of organ (heart: 7.84; liver: 4.06; lung: 13.04; kidney: 9.86), while the mean age at the time of transplantation was 7.99 years, IQR [ 1 – 14 ].

evidence_items.notes: These are ages at registry enrollment and transplantation, not disease onset per se. Disease-specific onset ages are not provided for the target gene-associated diseases. The lung cohort (relevant to ABCA3) had a mean enrollment age of 13.04 years. The kidney cohort (relevant to HNF1B, UMOD) had a mean enrollment age of 9.86 years.
inference_basis: pediatric cohort age statistics in Results section
